scripts.text: Ah, I sense that you are a warrior that has been to Valhalla. You who have been reborn... We are here to look after you.
scripts.translation: ..？啊，我感受到你是一位曾前往瓦尔哈拉的勇士。重生归来的你...我们会在这里守护你。

scripts.text: Do not let evil conquer your soul. You have enough courage and power to overcome the hardest situation. May God bless you...
scripts.translation: 别让邪恶侵占你的灵魂。你有足够的勇气和力量，度过最艰难的困境。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text: It is good to see you again, Brother {0}. Once again, God's grace has caused our paths to cross.
scripts.translation: 啊，很高兴再次见到你，兄弟{0}。上帝的恩典让我们的道路再次交汇。

scripts.text: It is good to see you once again, Sister {0}. The grace of God has brought you once more before me.
scripts.translation: 很高兴再次见到你，姐妹{0}。上帝的恩典再次让你来到我面前。

scripts.text: I'm pleased to see that you are continuing to lead the children of God on the right path. Is there anything I can help you with today?
scripts.translation: 很高兴看到你在继续引导上帝的子民走上正途。今天有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to help this Acolyte.
Thank you for your concern. I'm doing fine and am in good health. Please give my regards to your brothers and sisters.
scripts.translation: 感谢关心，我一切安好，身体也很健康。请代我向你的兄弟姐妹们问好。

scripts.text: Keep in mind that we are God's messengers on this Earth. Always remember that we must always help others.
scripts.translation: 记住，我们是上帝在人间的使者。无论何时，都应帮助他人。

scripts.text: Ah, that's a good idea. Helping young Acolytes should also be one of a Priest's priorities.
scripts.translation: 啊，这是个好主意。帮助年轻的服事，也应是牧师优先考虑的事。

scripts.text: However, there are certain things that an Acolyte must do alone. All Acolytes must complete their divine test by themselves.
scripts.translation: 不过，有些事服事必须独自完成。所有服事都必须独自完成神圣的考验。

scripts.text: I hope you will assist your Acolyte friend in the second test, the spiritual training.
scripts.translation: 希望你能在第二项考验——灵性修行中，帮助你的服事朋友。

scripts.text: You need to bring ^0000FF1 Rosary^000000 in order to accompany an Acolyte in spiritual training. If you have one of those, I can send you to the test area now.
scripts.translation: 陪同服事参加灵性修行，需要携带1个念珠。带了的话，我现在就能送你去考场。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Do you wish to help him out during the spiritual training?
scripts.translation: 你愿意在灵性修行中帮助他吗？

scripts.text: I will now send you to the training place for Acolytes. Please send my regards to Brother Peter...
scripts.translation: 现在送你去服事的修行场所。请代我向彼得兄弟问好...

scripts.text: I hope you will assist this Acolyte in becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我希望你能协助这位服事成为牧师。

scripts.text: Unfortunately you didn't bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000. You need one of those in order to be in the testing area.
scripts.translation: 可惜，你没带念珠。必须带一个，才能进入考场。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I see, take your time. Don't forget to bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000...
scripts.translation: 明白了，慢慢准备。别忘了带念珠... ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: You must be strong. Have faith, as you are loved by God. I pray the wounds of the body are healed soon...
scripts.translation: 要坚强，也要坚守信仰，上帝爱着你。我祈祷你身上的伤早日痊愈...

scripts.text: God, please look after your poor children. Help them overcome their hardships and difficulties. Refresh their spirits...
scripts.translation: 上帝啊，请眷顾您受苦的子民。帮助他们渡过艰难困苦，让他们重振精神...

scripts.text: I hope my invocation has eased your pain. Now please go forth and spread God's message. May God be with you...
scripts.translation: 愿我的祈祷能减轻你的痛苦。去传播上帝的旨意吧。愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text: I want to be an Acolyte.
I want to be a Priest.
If you wish to become an Acolyte, please visit the other room.
scripts.translation: ...如果你想成为服事，请去隔壁的房间。

scripts.text: Oh I see. However, you must first become an Acolyte before becoming a Priest. Please visit the other room.
scripts.translation: 原来如此。不过，你必须先成为服事，才能成为牧师。请去隔壁的房间。

scripts.text: Please make yourself at home. On Earth, nowhere is safer than this Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 请自便。在世间，没有比这座圣堂更安全的地方了。

scripts.text: Priests have the authority to perform and administer religious rites.
scripts.translation: 牧师有权主持宗教仪式。

scripts.text: You must first be thoroughly disciplined as an Acolyte before you can be promoted to the position of Priest.
scripts.translation: 要晋升为牧师，必须先以服事的身份接受严格的修行。

scripts.text: When you reach Acolyte Job level 40, you will be able to apply for the Priest test.
scripts.translation: 服事职业等级达到40级，就可以申请参加牧师考验。

scripts.text: If you pass the test, you will be able to use more powerful skills that will be effective against Demon and Undead creatures...
scripts.translation: 通过考验后，你就能使用更强大的技能，有效对抗恶魔与不死系生物...

scripts.text: With all of your ability, you will play an important role in towns and dungeons.
scripts.translation: 凭借这些能力，你将在城镇和地下城中发挥重要作用。

scripts.text: Our duty and obligation as Priests is to devote ourselves to helping others without expecting reward.
scripts.translation: 作为牧师，我们的职责和义务是无私奉献，帮助他人，而不求任何回报。

scripts.text: As we help others, we must not expect to treat us in a similar fashion. To be a great Priest is your choice and responsibility, not anyone else's.
scripts.translation: 帮助他人时，不应期待对方以同样的方式回报。你应当以身作则，但身为凡人，也有自己的限度。

scripts.text: However, those who receive should be polite. You should give an outstanding example, but you should also have your limits as a human.
scripts.translation: 不过，接受帮助的人也应有礼貌。你应当以身作则，但身为凡人，也有自己的限度。

scripts.text: I hope I explained enough of the class. Why don't you go outside and talk to some of the other Priests if you want to learn more about our way of life?
scripts.translation: 关于这个职业，我想已经说明得够多了。若想进一步了解牧师的生活，不妨去外面和其他牧师聊聊。

scripts.text: Please make yourself at home. Nowhere on Earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 请自便。普隆德拉圣堂是世上最安全的地方。
愿上帝保佑你，姐妹。有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Priest.
I see. So you wish to be a Priest. God will be delighted by your decision and will bless you.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，你想成为牧师。上帝会因你的决定而喜悦，并赐福于你。

scripts.text: I am Bishop Paul Cervantes, and am in charge of the Prontera Parish.
scripts.translation: 我是保罗·塞万提斯主教，负责普隆德拉教区。

scripts.text: I am glad to meet a person as eager and devoted to God such as yourself.
scripts.translation: 很高兴遇到像你这样热忱、虔诚侍奉上帝的人。

scripts.text: If you set your mind on becoming a Priest, you must undergo several tests. Only Acolytes who reach job level 40 are qualified for testing.
scripts.translation: 决心成为牧师，就必须接受几项考验。只有职业等级达到40级的服事，才有资格参加。

scripts.text: If you satisfy the requirements, I suggest that you apply for the Priest job first. Do you wish to apply now?
scripts.translation: 若已符合条件，我建议先提交牧师转职申请。现在要申请吗？

scripts.text: I need some time to think about it...
You are not yet qualified to be a Priest. Please go out into the world and broaden your experiences.
scripts.translation: 你还不符合成为牧师的条件。请去外面的世界历练，丰富你的阅历吧。

scripts.text: There are still things that you must learn as an Acolyte. However, I look forward to meeting you again very soon.
scripts.translation: 作为服事，你还有很多东西要学。不过，我期待很快能再次见到你。

scripts.text: I strongly recommend that you use all of these skill points before you apply for the Priest job change test.
scripts.translation: 点。我强烈建议你在申请牧师转职测试之前，把这些技能点全部用完。

scripts.text: Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Brother {0}.
scripts.translation: 现在，我来说明牧师的三重试炼。这些考验会带来不少苦难，但愿你能完成，兄弟。 {0}

scripts.text: Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Sister {0}.
scripts.translation: 现在，我来说明牧师的三重试炼。这些考验会带来不少苦难，但愿你能完成，姐妹。 {0}

scripts.text: For the First Trial, you will make a pilgrimage, and visit three acscetic Priests in a specific order.
scripts.translation: 第一重试炼是朝圣：按指定顺序拜访三位苦修牧师。

scripts.text: The Second Trial will consist of spiritual training. You must resist the temptations of Demons and the Undead.
scripts.translation: 第二重试炼是灵性修行。你必须抵御恶魔与不死者的诱惑。

scripts.text: In the Final Trial, you will promise your devotion to God. Your willingness to sacrifice yourself will also be questioned.
scripts.translation: 最后一重试炼，你要向上帝宣誓虔诚奉献。你是否愿意牺牲自己，也会受到考验。

scripts.text: Acolytes that have reached Job Level 50 will be exempt from the First Trial, the pilgrimage, as they have already demonstrated their enthusiasm and devotion.
scripts.translation: 职业等级达到50级的服事，已证明自己的热忱与虔诚，可以免去第一重试炼——朝圣。

scripts.text: I can see the great effort you have exerted to reach job level 50. You have been a loyal servant to God.
scripts.translation: 我看得出，你为达到职业等级50级付出了许多努力。你一直是上帝忠诚的仆人。

scripts.text: Now, you may go directly go to the Second Trial: Spiritual Training. For this training, you may bring a Priest with you.
scripts.translation: 现在，你可以直接参加第二重试炼——灵性修行。修行时可以请一位牧师同行。

scripts.text: I have no doubt that you will do a good job by yourself. However, it will be easier with the aid of a Brother or Sister that has already become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我相信你独自也能完成得很好。不过，有已成为牧师的兄弟姐妹协助，会容易一些。

scripts.text: Well, are you ready for the Spiritual Training?
scripts.translation: 准备好参加灵性修行了吗？

scripts.text: Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你去修行场地。到了后，请找负责修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text: May God give you the strength to overcome your fears...
scripts.translation: 愿上帝赐你克服恐惧的力量...

scripts.text: Well, let me tell you the order of the ascetic Priests that you must visit for your pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 我来说明朝圣时拜访三位苦修牧师的顺序。
隆德拉废墟东北方的鲁

scripts.text: Second, please visit Sister Mathilda. She is located in
scripts.translation: 其次，拜访玛蒂尔达修女。她在普

scripts.text: an area near Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 隆德拉西南方、梦罗克附近。

scripts.text: The third Priest you must visit is Father Yosuke. He is in a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 第三位是阳介神父。他在普隆德拉西北方的野外。

scripts.text: Well then, I wish you a safe journey. If you have any questions, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation: 那么，祝你旅途平安。如果有任何问题，请询问塞西莉亚修女。

scripts.text: When you return from your pilgrimage, I will let you know
scripts.translation: 朝圣归来后，我会说明下一

scripts.text: I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, brother.
scripts.translation: 兄弟，愿你继续履行上帝仆人的使命。

scripts.text: I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, sister.
scripts.translation: 姐妹，愿你继续履行上帝仆人的使命。

scripts.text: May I ask you the reason you're still here? You didn't forget your pilgrimage, did you?
scripts.translation: 请问你为什么还在这里？你没有忘记你的朝圣之旅吧？

scripts.text: Sorry father, I need to check the order.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，神父，我想确认拜访顺序

scripts.text: No no no, not at all.
Ah, I see. I will let you know the order of pilgrimage again, and hope that you will have a safe journey.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，我再说一遍朝圣的顺序。愿你旅途平安。

scripts.text: First, meet Father Rubalkabara. He's at the Northeast of the Prontera ruins.
scripts.translation: 首先，拜访鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父。他在普隆德拉废墟东北方。

scripts.text: Then, remember to meet Sister Mathilda. She's somewhere near the town of Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 然后，记得拜访玛蒂尔达修女。她在普隆德拉西南方、梦罗克附近。

scripts.text: And lastly, please seek out Father Yosuke. He is in the a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 最后，寻找阳介神父。他在普隆德拉西北方的野外。

scripts.text: Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. If you want more information, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation: 那么，我会为你祈祷旅途平安。如果你需要更多信息，请去问塞西莉亚修女。

scripts.text: When you get back from the pilgrimage, I will let you know the next test.
scripts.translation: 朝圣归来后，我会说明下一项考验。

scripts.text: I see. But still, if you have any questions, you may wish to ask Sister Cecilia. She will address any of your concerns.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。不过，如果你有任何问题，不妨去问问塞西莉亚修女。她会解答你的疑惑。

scripts.text: Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. May God bless you...
scripts.translation: 那么，我会祈祷你旅途平安。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text: I see you have returned from your meeting with Father Rubalkabara. How is he doing? I am worried about his health, since he's been there all alone...
scripts.translation: 看来你拜访鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父回来了。他近来如何？他一直独自在那里，我很担心他的身体...

scripts.text: For your next quest, you should meet Sister Mathilda. I shall be awaiting your safe return.
scripts.translation: 接下来，去拜访玛蒂尔达修女。我会等你平安归来。

scripts.text: I see that you have returned from your journey to meet Sister Mathilda. She has been meditating in the hot, dry desert for a long time.
scripts.translation: 看来你拜访玛蒂尔达修女回来了。她已在炎热干燥的沙漠中冥想许久。

scripts.text: Finally, it is now time for you to meet Father Yosuke. He is doing penance somewhere around a field Northwest of Prontera. Please seek him out, and then return here to me.
scripts.translation: 最后，该去拜访阳介神父了。他在普隆德拉西北方的野外苦修赎罪。找到他后，再回来见我。

scripts.text: Now it is time to begin your spiritual training. As I mentioned before, you may bring a Priest to help you during this training.
scripts.translation: 现在，该开始灵性修行了。之前说过，这项修行可以请一位牧师来协助。

scripts.text: Although you cannot receive their help throughout all of the testing, they can at least help you during the spiritual training.
scripts.translation: 虽然不是每项考验都能得到他们的帮助，但灵性修行期间，可以请他们协助。

scripts.text: Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你去修行场地。到了后，请找负责修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text: You seem confident about the spiritual training. Shall we begin?
scripts.translation: 看来你对灵性修行很有信心。开始吧？

scripts.text: Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你去修行场地。到了后，请找负责修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text: You look tired and exhausted. However, you must endure even more suffering once you become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 你看起来很疲惫。不过，一旦成为牧师，你必须忍受更多的苦难。

scripts.text: Please endure these trials for the sake of your dream. Why don't you challenge the spiritual training again?
scripts.translation: 为了梦想，请坚持完成这些考验。再挑战一次灵性修行吧？

scripts.text: Good. I will send you to the training ground. Please ask for help from Brother Peter.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你去修行场地。请向彼得兄弟寻求帮助。

scripts.text: I am glad that you've done well with the spiritual training. Congratulations. You are now qualified to be called a Priest.
scripts.translation: 很高兴你顺利完成灵性修行。恭喜，你现在已具备成为牧师的资格。

scripts.text: Now, you must go and swear your devotion to God with Sister Cecilia. Don't be nervous...
scripts.translation: 现在，去找塞西莉亚修女，向上帝宣誓虔诚奉献。别紧张...

scripts.text: Just answer honestly, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation: 只需诚实回答，并倾听上帝在你心中轻声的话语。

scripts.text: Hmm? You haven't made your oath yet...? Without the conviction of an oath to God, you may be tempted by evil at anytime.
scripts.translation: 嗯？还没宣誓...？若没有向上帝立誓的坚定信念，随时都可能受到邪恶诱惑。

scripts.text: You should go to sister Cecilia and promise your devotion to God. Return here with honor, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation: 去找塞西莉亚修女，向上帝许下奉献的誓言。光荣地归来，倾听上帝在你心中轻声诉说的话语。

scripts.text: You have remaining skills points. Please use these skill points to upgrade your skills, and then return to me.
scripts.translation: 你还有剩余的技能点。请使用这些技能点升级你的技能，然后回来找我。

scripts.text: Congratulations, you have completed the trials required of all Priests. Let me promote you to the position of Priest right away.
scripts.translation: 恭喜，你完成了牧师必须经历的所有考验。现在就为你举行晋升仪式。

scripts.text: God, grant your power to your servant standing before you.
scripts.translation: 上帝啊，请将您的力量赐予面前的仆

scripts.text: Let him send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation: 人。让他将您的旨意传至天涯海角。

scripts.text: Let her send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation: 上帝啊，请将您的力量赐予面前的仆人。让她将您的旨意传至天涯海角。

scripts.text: Make this servant of yours an instrument of your miraculous works...
scripts.translation: 让您的这位仆人成为施行神迹的器皿...

scripts.text: Now you are born again as a Priest. I congratulate you, and hope you will greatly help other people for the rest of your life.
scripts.translation: 如今，你以牧师的身份获得新生。恭喜你，愿你在往后的岁月里，尽心帮助他人。

scripts.text: This book is for you. I hope it will aid you in spreading God's message on earth.
scripts.translation: 这本书送给你。我希望它能帮助你向世人传播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text: In commemoration of your job change, I am giving you a bible. This will lighten your way to the path of righteousness.
scripts.translation: 为纪念你的转职，赠你一本圣经。它会照亮你通往正义的道路。

scripts.text: You've shown great effort, and have made admirable progress in your personal quest for holiness. Please lead your life as a sincere Priest...
scripts.translation: 你付出了许多努力，在追求圣洁的道路上取得了令人钦佩的进步。愿你以真诚之心，履行牧师的职责...

scripts.text: May god bless you, {0}. It brings my heart joy to see that you working hard to carry out the will of God.
scripts.translation: 愿上帝保佑你，。看到你努力践行上帝的旨意，我很欣慰。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, you haven't chosen a job yet? Why don't you consider devoting your life to God?
scripts.translation: 哦，你还没有选择职业吗？为什么不考虑将你的生命奉献给上帝呢？

scripts.text: You can lead a fulfilling life as an Acolyte, helping out other people in need.
scripts.translation: 作为服事，你可以过上充实的生活，帮助那些需要帮助的人。

scripts.text: If you're interested, please ask the Priest in the other room. You won't ever regret the choice to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 如果你感兴趣，请去隔壁房间找牧师咨询。你绝不会后悔选择成为服事。

scripts.text: When you reach Job level 40 as an Acolyte, you can be promoted to a Priest.
scripts.translation: 当你的服事职业等级达到40级时，你可以晋升为牧师。

scripts.text: Take your time, and decide what job will be the best for you.
scripts.translation: .不必着急，慢慢考虑哪个职业最适合你。

scripts.text: Welcome to Prontera parish. How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 愿上帝保佑你，。欢迎来到普隆德拉教区。有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Messengers of God are usually known as Priests. After becoming an Acolyte, you can train with the goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation: 上帝的使者，通常被称为牧师。成为服事后，就可以朝着牧师的目标修行。

scripts.text: Servants of God are prohibited to use weapons based on blades. For us, the meaning of battle with monsters is not in the killing, but in the enlightening of their souls.
scripts.translation: 上帝的仆人不得使用刀剑类武器。对我们而言，与魔物战斗不是为了杀戮，而是为了启迪它们的灵魂。

scripts.text: I see. Well, feel free to relax and make yourself at home. Nowhere on earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。请放松，把这里当作你的家。世界上没有比普隆德拉圣堂更安全的地方了。
愿上帝保佑你，姐妹。请问你为何而来？

scripts.text: May I ask what brings you here?
I wish to become a Priest.
I see. You've devoted yourself to God. Many Acolytes wish to become Priests to continue on their personal journey towards holiness.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，你已决心奉献于上帝。许多服事都想成为牧师，继续走在追求圣洁的道路上。

scripts.text: Let me introduce myself. I am Cecilia Margarita, and I am in charge of part of the Priest job change process.
scripts.translation: 自我介绍一下，我是塞西莉亚·玛格丽塔，负责牧师转职的部分考验。

scripts.text: I've been supporting many people in becoming Priests ever since I joined the Prontera Parish. That is one of my main responsibilities.
scripts.translation: 加入普隆德拉教区以来，我帮助了许多人成为牧师。这是我的主要职责之一。

scripts.text: In order to become a Priest, you must complete 3 trials. A pilgrimage, a session of spiritual training, and an oath of devotion to God.
scripts.translation: 想成为牧师，必须完成三重试炼：朝圣、灵性修行，以及向上帝宣誓奉献。

scripts.text: If you wish to become a servant of God, please apply for the Priest job with Bishop Paul, and complete all 3 trials.
scripts.translation: 想成为上帝的仆人，请向保罗主教申请转职为牧师，并完成三重试炼。

scripts.text: If you experience a problem during any of your trials, feel free to visit me. I will help you as much as I can.
scripts.translation: 如果你在考验中遇到任何问题，请随时来找我。我会尽我所能帮助你。

scripts.text: Make yourself at home. I insist that you recover and take a rest in this Sanctuary. May God bless you...
scripts.translation: 不必拘束，请务必在圣堂里好好休息，恢复体力。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text: Ah, you've started your pilgrimage. Please do your best to accomplish this first trial.
scripts.translation: 啊，你已踏上朝圣之旅。请尽力完成第一重试炼。

scripts.text: The first Priest you must meet is Father Rubalkabara. He is in the ruins Northeast of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 你必须见的第一位牧师是鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父。他在普隆德拉东北方的废墟中。

scripts.text: Travel one field North from Prontera, and then three fields East, and you will arrive at the ruins.
scripts.translation: 从普隆德拉向北走一张地图，再向东走三张地图，就能到废墟。

scripts.text: Of course, you can also head 1 field East from Prontera, then go 1 field north, and then go 2 fields East...
scripts.translation: 也可以先从普隆德拉向东走一张地图，再向北走一张，最后向东走两张...

scripts.text: Father Rubalkabara will be at the entrance of the Prontera Ruins. Be careful. That place is a habitat for aggressive Chocos.
scripts.translation: 鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父在普隆德拉废墟入口。小心，那里有会主动攻击的巧克猴。

scripts.text: After meeting Father Rubalkabara, please visit Sister Mathilda and Father Yosuke. You can check your quest progress with me if you have any questions later.
scripts.translation: 拜访鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父后，再去拜访玛蒂尔达修女和阳介神父。之后若有疑问，可以来找我确认任务进度。

scripts.text: Well then, have a good journey. Please don't give up to short lived tribulations, and I hope that you accomplish your goals.
scripts.translation: 那么，祝你旅途愉快。不要因一时的磨难而放弃，愿你达成自己的目标。

scripts.text: Oh, you've met Father Rubalkabara. Now it's time for you to visit Sister Mathilda. She is near a town named Morocc.
scripts.translation: 哦，你见过鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父了。现在该去拜访玛蒂尔达修女，她在梦罗克城附近。

scripts.text: She has been training her religious discipline somewhere in a field North of Morocc. If you look around that field, you will be able to find her.
scripts.translation: 她在梦罗克北方的野外修行。在那张地图四处找找，就能找到她。

scripts.text: Of course, sometimes I want to devote myself to training like those other Priests, but I have my duty to assist those Acolytes applying for the Priest job.
scripts.translation: 当然，有时我也想像其他牧师那样专心修行，但我有责任协助那些申请成为牧师的服事。

scripts.text: But I believe this is God's will, and that this is the work he has intended me to do as his servant. Have a safe journey, and come back safely.
scripts.translation: 但我相信，这是上帝的旨意，是祂安排我这个仆人履行的职责。愿你旅途平安，安全归来。

scripts.text: Now, the final Priest that you must meet is Father Yosuke. I've heard that he is training near a lake located Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 最后要拜访的是阳介神父。听说他在普隆德拉西北方的湖边修行。

scripts.text: From Prontera, travel one field North, and then two fields towards the West. You may also travel two fields West first, and then travel one field to the North.
scripts.translation: 从普隆德拉向北走一张地图，再向西走两张。也可以先向西走两张，再向北走一张。

scripts.text: Although there are still two trials awaiting you, I have faith that you will be able to accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest...
scripts.translation: 虽然还有两项考验等着你，但我相信你能达成成为牧师的目标...

scripts.text: Welcome. You demonstrated great effort to accomplish your first trial. Now, speak to Bishop Paul so that you can begin your next trial on your path to Priesthood.
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来，你努力完成了第一重试炼。去找保罗主教，开始牧师之路上的下一重试炼吧。
姐妹...灵性修行比朝圣艰难得多，但我相信你。 {0}

scripts.text: The spiritual training is much more difficult than the pilgrimage, but I believe in you.
scripts.translation: 弟...灵性修行比朝圣艰难得多，但我相信你。

scripts.text: I hope that you find someone who has already become a Priest to help during the spiritual training. Good luck, and have faith.
scripts.translation: 希望你能找一位牧师，在灵性修行中帮助你。祝你好运，要坚守信仰。

scripts.text: Oh, you haven't finished the spiritual training yet?
scripts.translation: 哦，还没完成灵性修行吗？

scripts.text: I cannot let you know the specific details, but as long as you believe in yourself and have faith in all that is good, you will succeed.
scripts.translation: 我不能透露具体细节，但只要相信自己，坚信一切美好，你就会成功。

scripts.text: Please speak to Father Peter in the test hall for more details. He is a close friend of Bishop Paul and may give you some useful tips for the spiritual training.
scripts.translation: 详细情况，请去考场问彼得神父。他是保罗主教的好友，也许能给你一些灵性修行的建议。

scripts.text: Yes, I understand that you've been through a really difficult situation. However, do not give up and succumb to temptation. You must be able to resist evil to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我明白，你经历了艰难的考验。但不要放弃，也不要屈服于诱惑。想成为牧师，就必须抵御邪恶。

scripts.text: If you know somebody who has already become a Priest, ask them to help you during your spiritual training.
scripts.translation: 若认识已经成为牧师的人，就请他们在灵性修行中帮你。

scripts.text: May God give you guidance and protection. When you complete your training, please come back to me.
scripts.translation: 愿上帝指引并保护你。完成修行后，请回到我这里。

scripts.text: Welcome! I'm so glad to see you've come back! Now, there is one last trial left for you to complete.
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来！很高兴又见到你！现在只剩最后一重试炼了。

scripts.text: I hope that you've reflected on what you've said last time, and that you now have the attitude to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 来。希望你已经反省过上次说的话，如今有了成为牧师应有的心态。
姐妹...现在，正式开始牧师宣誓。放轻松，依照本心回答就好。 {0}

scripts.text: We will now begin your formal oath for the Priesthood. Make yourself comfortable, and just answer with your heart.
scripts.translation: ...现在，正式开始牧师宣誓。放轻松，依照本心回答就好。
姐妹，你愿意将生命奉献给上帝吗？ {0}

scripts.text: to give your life to God?
Aw...? How could you give me that kind of answer? I assume you're not ready to be a Priest yet...
scripts.translation: 哎呀...？你怎么能给出这样的回答呢？看来你还没有准备好成为一名牧师...

scripts.text: You should reflect a little more on the teachings of holiness and come back later. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is weak.
scripts.translation: 再用心体悟圣洁的教诲，之后再来吧。心志不坚定，是不能成为牧师的。

scripts.text: Will you take advantage of the holy abilities given by God for selfish, destructive or greedy ends?
scripts.translation: 你会为满足私欲、破坏或贪婪，滥用上帝赐予的神圣力量吗？

scripts.text: Aw...? God won't grant you the power of holiness if your goals aren't just and pure. Meditate on your motivations for a while, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation: 啊...？如果你的目标不够正当纯粹，上帝就不会赐予你神圣的力量。静心反思自己的动机，再来找我吧。

scripts.text: Think about the qualities that make Priests people of respect. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is not in accordance with God.
scripts.translation: 想想看，牧师具备哪些受人尊敬的品质。心灵若不顺从上帝，就无法成为牧师。

scripts.text: Will you help aid others, even complete strangers, in battles by easing their suffering?
scripts.translation: 你愿意在战斗中帮助他人、减轻他们的痛苦，即使对方是素不相识的人吗？

scripts.text: No, no. You've got the wrong idea. God authorizes us to use his power to support his children. You must help people in danger: it is your obligation.
scripts.translation: 不，你想错了。上帝赐予我们力量，是为了扶助祂的子民。帮助身陷危险的人，是你的义务。

scripts.text: Go and observe the adventurers that are fighting for peace in this world. They will teach you what you must do in order to help them.
scripts.translation: 去看看那些为世界和平而战的冒险者吧。从他们身上，你会明白该怎样帮助他们。

scripts.text: Are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the sake of others?
scripts.translation: 你愿意为他人牺牲自己吗？

scripts.text: How can you say no...? That's one of the basic principles of Priesthood. You must value the welfare of others over your own safety.
scripts.translation: 你怎么能说“不”呢...？这是牧师的基本准则之一。你必须将他人的福祉置于自己的安全之上。

scripts.text: Go and think about the value of suffering and the meaning of sacrifice. When you think you understand more about helping those in need, come back to me.
scripts.translation: 去想想痛苦的价值和牺牲的意义。当你觉得自己更懂得如何帮助有需要的人时，再来找我。

scripts.text: Will you repeatly say the same phrase in public in order to send God's message to his children?
scripts.translation: 为了向上帝的子民传达祂的旨意，你会在公共场合反复说同一句话吗？

scripts.text: No no no... You've got it wrong. Even though your purpose is to spread God's message, no one will eagerly accept what you say when you spam text.
scripts.translation: 不不不...你想错了。即使是为了传播上帝的旨意，不停刷屏，也不会有人乐意听。

scripts.text: You must be a moral person, and display maturity and respect to other players. This kind of attitude applies for all classes,
scripts.translation: ..要有良好的品行，成熟行事，尊重其他玩家。我相信，这份要求适用于所有

scripts.text: Will you lure many monsters to help your party members level up?
scripts.translation: 为了帮助队友升级，你会引来大群魔物吗？

scripts.text: No, you won't. Luring many monsters does more harm than good. There is no exception. That behavior is totally unacceptable.
scripts.translation: 不，不该这样做。引来大群魔物弊大于利，没有例外。这种行为完全不可接受。

scripts.text: Even if it looks like you are aiding your party members, such action results in bad karma. Please reflect on that for a while.
scripts.translation: 看似是在帮队友，实际却会招致恶果。请好好反思。

scripts.text: Will you follow God, no matter what it takes, even if he demands you to kill yourself?
scripts.translation: 无论付出什么代价，你都愿意追随上帝，即使祂要求你结束自己的生命吗？

scripts.text: With that spirit, you can't be a Priest. If it is God's will to sacrifice yourself for a good purpose, you must carry out God's will as his servant.
scripts.translation: 抱着这样的心态，是不能成为牧师的。若上帝要你为善而牺牲，身为祂的仆人，就应遵行祂的旨意。

scripts.text: Besides, God has also given Priests the resurrection power. Think about the meaning of life and death again, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation: 此外，上帝也赋予了牧师复活的力量。请重新思考生与死的意义，然后再来找我。
姐妹...你已展现出对上帝的虔诚。你愿意发誓，余生都遵循他的教诲吗？ {0}

scripts.text: You have demonstrated your devotion to God. Will you swear to adhere to his teachings for the rest of your days?
scripts.translation: 弟...你已展现出对上帝的虔诚。你愿意发誓，余生都遵循他的教诲吗？

scripts.text: Now, you have completed your oath of Priesthood and accomplished all three trials required to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 你已完成牧师宣誓，也完成了成为牧师所需的三重试炼。

scripts.text: Now go to Bishop Paul. And remember, we are all brothers and sisters in the eyes of God. Peace be with you...
scripts.translation: 去找保罗主教吧。记住，在上帝眼中，我们都是兄弟姐妹。愿平安与你同在...

scripts.text: You've completed all three trials required for the Priesthood. Bishop Paul is now waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 完成了成为牧师所需的全部三重试炼。保罗主教正在等你。
欢迎，姐妹！很高兴又见到你！ {0}

scripts.text: So good to see you again!
Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation: 你是来帮服事朋友参加灵性修行的？太好了~相信你能做得很好。

scripts.text: Remember, no matter how much you want to help this Acolyte, this is not your quest.
scripts.translation: 记住，无论多想帮这位服事，这都不是你的任务。

scripts.text: You may assist and lighten your friend's burden, but you take upon this task for yourself.
scripts.translation: 你可以帮忙减轻朋友的负担，不过，这份协助是你自愿承担的。

scripts.text: Are you gonna help him right now?
Go for it! As your Acolyte enters, the test will begin. Now, I will send you to the testing area.
scripts.translation: 去吧！你的服事朋友进场后，测试就会开始。现在送你去考场。

scripts.text: Well, so long as you arrive in time to help your friend, it will be okay.
scripts.translation: ？为什么？好吧，只要能及时赶去帮朋友就行。

scripts.text: Oh, I keep forgetting that he was promoted to Bishop. I think I'm supposed to call him Bishop Paul, or 'His Excellency.' Haha~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我总是忘记他已经晋升为主教了。我想我应该叫他保罗主教，或者“阁下”。哈哈~

scripts.text: Anyway, let me give you a brief explanation of the spiritual training. Are you familiar with what the spiritual training is for Priests?
scripts.translation: 总之，先简单说明一下灵性修行。你了解牧师的灵性修行吗？

scripts.text: Haha, I like you! But it never hurts to have too much information. The more well informed you are, the more easily you'll pass the test!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，我欣赏你！不过，多了解一些总没坏处。知道得越清楚，越容易通过测试！

scripts.text: Oh, no need to be sorry. I'm here to give you the information you need anyway. So, don't worry.
scripts.translation: 哦，不必道歉，我本来就是来说明情况的。别担心。

scripts.text: In spiritual training, you will be defeating evil creatures. Creatures of the Undead and Demons are all evil. In choosing to serve darkness, they are our enemies!
scripts.translation: 灵性修行中，你要击败邪恶的生物。不死者与恶魔都是邪恶的，既然选择侍奉黑暗，就是我们的敌人！

scripts.text: There are too many evil creatures that roam this world against the will of God. Innocents suffer as a result of their malignance.
scripts.translation: 这个世界上有太多违背上帝旨意的邪恶生物在游荡。无辜的人们因此遭受苦难。

scripts.text: We, as Priests, are obligated to exterminate all those creatures, thus spreading love and peace.
scripts.translation: 我们作为牧师，有义务消灭所有这些生物，从而传播爱与和平。

scripts.text: This training will test your ability to eliminate evil. Since this trial is pretty difficult to be accomplished by yourself,
scripts.translation: 这项修行考验你消灭邪恶的能力。独自完成相当困难，所以可以的

scripts.text: I recommend getting help from a Priest if you can.
scripts.translation: 话，最好请一位牧师帮忙。

scripts.text: If you are close to a Priest, you'd better ask him to assist you during this trial. Now, are you ready?
scripts.translation: 如果你和某位牧师关系不错，最好请他在试炼中协助你。那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Now, let the spiritual training begin. It's simple. Just kill them all. Show no mercy to the creatures of darkness!
scripts.translation: 现在，开始灵性修行。很简单，把它们全部杀掉。对黑暗生物，不必留情！

scripts.text: Hm? What is it you need?
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation: 我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事务要处理。等你方便的时候再回来吧。

scripts.text: Now, let the spiritual training begin. For the glory of God, for peace on earth, and goodwill towards all men...
scripts.translation: 现在，开始灵性修行。为了上帝的荣耀，为了世间和平，为了对世人的善意...

scripts.text: Hm? What is it you need?
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation: 我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事务要处理。等你方便的时候再回来吧。
欢迎，姐妹！很高兴见到你！ {0}

scripts.text: Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation: 你是来帮服事朋友参加灵性修行的？太好了~相信你能做得很好。

scripts.text: Well, another Acolyte is in the training ground right now. You'll need to wait a little bit longer...
scripts.translation: 现在另一位服事正在修行，还需要再等一会儿...

scripts.text: Please come back a little later. If this acolyte's done with the training, I will send you to the training area.
scripts.translation: 请稍后再来。等这位服事完成修行，我就送你去修行场地。

scripts.text: Please hold on for a while. Another acolyte is in the training ground right now.
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你想参加测试，请稍等片刻，然后再来找我。

scripts.text: Please hold on for a while. Another acolyte is in the training ground right now.
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你想参加测试，请稍等片刻，然后再来找我。

scripts.text: When the Priest applicant enters, 5 minutes will be given to complete this trial. Proceed slowly and help your Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 申请转职的服事进场后，这项试炼限时5分钟。请稳步前进，帮助你的服事朋友。

scripts.text: Enter through the warp at the end of the hall, where you will be lead to the next test hall.
scripts.translation: 通过大厅尽头的传送门，你将前往下一个测试大厅。

scripts.text: I will give you exactly 5 minutes! You must proceed slowly and eliminate the Zombies.
scripts.translation: 限时整整5分钟！稳步前进，消灭腐尸。

scripts.text: Slay all the zombies and go through the warp at the end of the hall. Make sure that you kill them all.
scripts.translation: 消灭所有腐尸，再进入大厅尽头的传送门。务必一个不留。

scripts.text: Well, look who's the ^660000BMOC^000000 now. That's '^660000B^000000ig ^660000M^000000an ^660000O^000000n ^660000C^000000ampus,' if you didn't know. By the way, I was being sarcastic. You know, if you didn't notice.
scripts.translation: 哟，看看现在谁成了BMOC。那是'Big Man On Campus'的缩写，你不知道吗？顺便说一句，我是在讽刺你。你没听出来吧。 ^660000^000000^660000^000000^660000^000000^660000^000000^660000^000000

scripts.text: Alright, alright, for old time's sake, I'll let you pass me. But only this once. But I better not catch you again! This is evil turf, you hear?!
scripts.translation: 好吧好吧，看在老交情上，让你过去，就这一次。别再让我抓到你！这可是邪恶的地盘，听见没有？！

scripts.text: You must be here training hard to be a Priest. Funny, I know a lot of God's servants, actually. They tell me that it's really tough serving that God guy all the time. So... So ^666666tiring^000000 and ^666666unrewarding^000000.
scripts.translation: 来这里刻苦修行，想当牧师吧？有意思，我还真认识不少上帝的仆人。他们说，整天侍奉上帝那个家伙，实在太辛苦了。那么...那么疲惫，又毫无回报。 ^666666^000000^666666^000000

scripts.text: I mean, people are always crying to Priests for help no matter where they are. And Priests never get anything in return...
scripts.translation: 我的意思是，无论在哪里，人们总是哭着向牧师求助。而牧师却得不到任何回报...

scripts.text: It's tragic really, how unappreciated Priests are.
scripts.translation: 牧师这么不受重视，真惨。随

scripts.text: It's so clear that any job is better. Anything at all...
scripts.translation: 便哪个职业都更好，哪个都行...

scripts.text: Wouldn't life be so much easier if you weren't a Priest? And it'd be so easy. All you'd have to do is quit right now...
scripts.translation: 不当牧师，日子不就轻松多了？而且很简单，现在放弃就行...

scripts.text: But how about this...? Now, isn't this an attractive sight? A nice, shiny new card. Mint condition. Not too many people have this you know. But I happen to have soooo many, my pockets hurt.
scripts.translation: 那这个呢...？很诱人吧？一张崭新闪亮的卡片，品相完美。没几个人有哦，可我偏偏多得口袋都装疼了。

scripts.text: Isn't it everyone's dream to have one of these? Think about it, being a Priest can only bring you suffering...
scripts.translation: 拥有这样一张卡片难道不是每个人的梦想吗？想想看，当牧师只会给你带来痛苦...

scripts.text: What are you doing here? You've already made your choice, there's no going back... Priest.
scripts.translation: 来这里做什么？你已经作出选择，没回头路了...牧师。

scripts.text: Besides, this is none of your business. Whether or not this Acolyte becomes a Priest isn't up to you. Now get out of here, before I get violent.
scripts.translation: 况且，这不关你的事。这个服事能不能成为牧师，不由你决定。趁我还没动手，赶紧走。

scripts.text: Now, why would you want to become a Priest? It's such a worthless, thankless job. If you want, I'll give you the chance to become a Novice. Then you can become something much better!
scripts.translation: 为什么想当牧师？这职业毫无价值，还吃力不讨好。愿意的话，我给你个机会变回初心者，这样就能选个更好的职业！

scripts.text: Of course, I'll let you redistribute your stat points by your base level. Now, isn't that a sweet deal...?
scripts.translation: 当然，还会按你的基础等级，让你重新分配属性点。很划算吧...？

scripts.text: I don't think you understood what I just offered. Think about it again. I mean, this is your one and only chance to undo your life mistakes. I mean, becoming an Acolyte?
scripts.translation: 看来你没听懂我的提议，再想想。这是你纠正人生错误的唯一机会。我是说，居然选择当服事？

scripts.text: Just don't become a Priest. I won't ask you more than once. Then you can choose a better job... perhaps a Swordman like me.
scripts.translation: 别当牧师就行，我只问这一次。你可以选个更好的职业...比如像我一样当剑士。

scripts.text: I don't want to be a Priest!
Excellent choice. Now, never return to this place. I shall return your job to Novice as you wish.
scripts.translation: 选得好，永远别再回来。如你所愿，让你变回初心者。

scripts.text: But if by chance we meet again,
I assure you... You won't be happy at all to see me.
scripts.translation: 保证...你绝不会高兴见到我。

scripts.text: ^330033All is doom, darkness and despair! Those who love you will betray you, and all that will be left is grieving and fury!^000000
scripts.translation: 一切皆是毁灭、黑暗与绝望！爱你的人会背叛你，剩下的只有悲伤与愤怒！ ^330033^000000

scripts.text: ^330033To choose to become a servant of God is to choose eternal pain!
scripts.translation: 选择成为上帝的仆人，就是选择永恒的痛苦！ ^330033

scripts.text: I shall personally see to that, mortal.^000000
scripts.translation: 凡人，我会亲手让它成真。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^330033You still wish to become a Priest?! Fool! Then, I shall not let you pass. Go back. Otherwise, you will not survive.^000000
scripts.translation: 还想当牧师？！蠢货！我不会让你通过。回去，否则别想活命。 ^330033^000000

scripts.text: ^330033It would be so easy for me to snap your fragile body in twain and grind your bones to dust.
scripts.translation: 把你脆弱的身体折成两段，再将骨头碾成粉末，对我来说易如反掌。滚回去 ^330033

scripts.text: ^330033It is no use to feign strength and courage. You are completely helpless before me. Your skills are laughable, and your weapons are but mere toys compared to my power.^000000
scripts.translation: 装出坚强勇敢的样子，毫无用处。在我面前，你无能为力。你的技能可笑至极，你的武器在我的力量面前，不过是玩具。 ^330033^000000

scripts.text: ^330033With just a wave of my hand, you will cease to exist. And no one will remember you. Tremble before the might of my infinite magic!^000000
scripts.translation: 只需我挥挥手，你就会消失无踪。没有人会记得你。在我无限的魔力面前颤抖吧！ ^330033^000000

scripts.text: ^330033When next we meet, I will shall escort you to a realm of suffering where you shall spend years immersed in excruciating pain.
scripts.translation: 下次见面，我会带你去苦难之境，让你在剧痛中煎熬多年。记住我的话... ^330033

scripts.text: I don't have any business with you, servant of God. Just pass through.
scripts.translation: 上帝的仆人，我跟你没什么好说的，过去吧。

scripts.text: I also know that Deviruchi, Doppelganger and the Dark Lord have all failed to convince you to turn away from the Priesthood.
scripts.translation: 我也知道，小恶魔、死灵和暗黑之王，都没能劝你放弃牧师之路。现在，

scripts.text: I can grant you any treasure you desire and infinite power at your fingertips. Powerful weapons that humans have never before seen...
scripts.translation: 我能赐你渴望的任何宝物，让你轻易掌握无尽力量。还有人类从未见过的强大武器...

scripts.text: Mountains of zeny that you cannot possibly hope to spend in a lifetime. Though, who's to say that your lifespan should be limited? Fame, power, immortality: It can all be yours.
scripts.translation: 堆积如山的Zeny，一辈子都花不完。不过，谁说你的寿命就该有限？名望、力量、永生，全都可以是你的。

scripts.text: I will be yours to summon at anytime. All other humans will dread making you their enemy. You will become the most powerful person in all of history!
scripts.translation: 我会随时听候你的召唤。所有人类都会惧怕与你为敌，你将成为史上最强之人！

scripts.text: Cease this foolishness of pursuing the Priesthood. Make a contract with me. The entire world is yours for the taking.
scripts.translation: 别再愚蠢地追求牧师之路，和我立下契约。整个世界，都将任你夺取。

scripts.text: Then we shall form a contract. You won't ever regret this moment...
scripts.translation: 那么，我们就签订契约吧。你绝不会后悔这一刻的...

scripts.text: You have made your choice. I will leave you alone for now, then. However, your training won't be as easy as you think.
scripts.translation: ..你做出了你的选择。那么，我现在就放过你。不过，你的修行可不会像你想象的那么轻松。

scripts.text: I shall be preparing my troops for you. The day will come when I shall enjoy watching you writhe in agony as my fiends slowly devour you.
scripts.translation: 我会为你准备好大军。总有一天，我会欣赏你痛苦扭动的模样，看我的恶魔慢慢将你吞噬。

scripts.text: Ah yes, so you're the young Acolyte who wishes to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 啊，原来你就是那位想要成为牧师的年轻服事啊。

scripts.text: I've received the message from Bishop Paul. Since you made the pilgrimage, I hope you accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我收到了保罗主教的消息。既然前来朝圣，愿你如愿成为牧师。

scripts.text: Also, if you have a chance, please visit this abbey again. It's a sacred place for our Church.
scripts.translation: 另外，如果有机会，请再次造访这座修道院。它是我们教会的圣地。

scripts.text: Well then, please head to your next destination for your pilgrimage. Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation: 那么，请前往你朝圣的下一站吧。旅途平安。

scripts.text: Please be hurry to the next destination for your pilgrimage. I hope you become a Priest soon.
scripts.translation: 请赶快前往朝圣的下一站吧。希望你能早日成为牧师。

scripts.text: May I ask why you have returned? Please go back and continue your religious practice.
scripts.translation: 请问你为何折返？请回去继续你的修行吧。

scripts.text: I have no idea what brought you here, but please excuse me.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你为何会来这里，请原谅我的怠慢。

scripts.text: However, at this point in your pilgrimage, I am not the person that you should be visiting.
scripts.translation: 不过，照你现在的朝圣进度，还不该来拜访我。

scripts.text: Perhaps you should ask Bishop Paul or Sister Cecilia once again. Well, may God be with you...
scripts.translation: 不妨再去问问保罗主教或塞西莉亚修女。愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text: We Priests are obliged to spread the message of God to
scripts.translation: 我们牧师有义务向世人传播

scripts.text: After you become a Priest, your travels may take you to the Morocc Pyramids. I hope that you may release the Undead there from the evil to which they are bound.
scripts.translation: 成为牧师后，你可能会去梦罗克金字塔历练。愿你让那里的不死者摆脱邪恶的束缚。

scripts.text: May I ask you the reason you came back? Please continue your training.
scripts.translation: 请问你回来的原因是什么？请继续你的修行。
准备成为牧师的学徒，是吧？

scripts.text: Well, you got the wrong person. If you're supposed to meet up with me at all, it'd be later.
scripts.translation: 找错人了。就算要来见我，也该晚些时候。
不过，弄错是你自己的事

scripts.text: Now, go back to Church, kid.

scripts.translation: 准备成为牧师的学徒，是吧？

scripts.text: Well, you got the wrong person. If you're supposed to meet up with me at all, it'd be later.
scripts.translation: 找错人了。就算要来见我，也该晚些时候。

scripts.text: But that's your own fault. Go back to Church.
scripts.translation: 不过，弄错是你自己的事。回教堂去。

scripts.text: I told you to go back to church.
Or do you want to live with me here for the rest of your life...?
scripts.translation: 难道你想在这里和我过一辈子...？

scripts.text: Just go be a Priest. This isn't a playground for kids.
scripts.translation: 去当你的牧师吧。这里不是小孩的游乐场。

scripts.text: ...Acolyte, you don't have any business with me here.
